entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. The order is VF55198.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... I see the order here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong color. It looked different online. The box is still unopened, so it should be easy for you.
I understand completely. Sometimes the on-screen color doesn't quite match reality. Let me just confirm the purchase date... It looks like it was delivered 43 days ago. Is that correct?

You are absolutely right. For a standard item like this helmet, you are well within the 90-day return window. We want to ensure you're happy with your gear, especially something as important for your safety. I've gone ahead and approved the return.

I am emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. You can just attach that to the box and drop it at any designated courier location. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. You should see it in your account within 3-5 business days after that.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
